facts.about: The Company was established in 1981. A joint venture agreement was signed between the Government of India and Suzuki Motor Corporation (SMC), Japan in 1982. The Company became a subsidiary of SMC in 2002.It is the market leader in passenger vehicle segment in India. In terms of production volume and sales, the Company is now SMC’s largest subsidiary. SMC currently holds 56.28% of its equity stake. The principal activities of the Company are manufacturing, purchase and sale of motor vehicles, components and spare parts.

business.summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited is an automotive company primarily engaged in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of motor vehicles, components, and spare parts. It generates revenue through the sale of these automotive products in both domestic and international markets.

scorecard.promised: Growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew 26% in Sep 2026 quarter; FY26 revenue grew 19.9%.
scorecard.evidence: Revenue growth is strong at 26% in Sep 2026, but full FY27 volume data is not yet finalized.

scorecard.delivered: Capital work in progress stands at ₹4,084 cr as of Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: With ₹4,084 cr in CWIP by mid-year, the ₹14,000 cr target requires significant acceleration in H2 FY27.

narrative.scoreline: Management is delivering robust top-line growth and capacity expansion, but operating margins are significantly trailing their sequential expansion claims.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Operating profit margin expanded sequentially to 8.8% due to lower costs and favorable forex.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Margins dropped to 8% in the following quarter (Jun 2026) and remain below FY26 levels.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Strong underlying demand with 190,000 unserved customer orders.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue growth accelerated to 26% YoY in Sep 2026, supporting the demand narrative.

bull: Revenue growth is accelerating, with Sep 2026 up 26% YoY compared to a 16% three-year trend.
The company is practically debt-free with a debt/equity ratio of 0.00x and ₹1.09L cr net worth.
Excellent cash generation with 5-year operating cash flow at 118% of total PAT.
bear: Operating margins have deteriorated from 12% in Mar 2026 to 9% in Sep 2026.
Net profit for Sep 2026 (₹2,466 cr) is the lowest in over two years despite record revenue.
Significant capex of ₹14,000 cr planned for FY27 may further pressure near-term free cash flow.
watch: Margin recovery in Q3 FY27 to validate management's cost and forex claims.
Execution of the ₹14,000 cr capex plan against current CWIP levels.
Impact of ERP migration on data accuracy as noted in annual report risks.

claims.claim: The company has strong underlying demand with 190,000 unserved customer orders at the end of the fiscal year.
claims.quote: As of the end of the fiscal year, around 190,000 customer orders remained unserved, and we are trying to service them fast, highlighting the strength of the underlying demand.

claims.claim: Two new units in Haryana and Gujarat will add 500,000 units of annual production capacity this fiscal year.
claims.quote: The second plant at the Kharkhoda facility and the fourth production line at the Hansalpur facility in Gujarat is set to become operational within this financial year.

claims.claim: Operating profit margin expanded sequentially to 8.8% in Q4 due to lower employee costs, discounts, and favorable forex.
claims.quote: Sequentially, the operating profit margin EBIT has expanded to 8.8% of net sales compared to 8.1% in quarter 3 of the financial year.
